Meta.Author: Flemming Busman
Meta.Description: IMPORTANT: the Axe-Fx III has NO fixed CC assignments - every function is assigned a CC number by the user in SETUP > MIDI/Remote. This definition uses a documented convention; configure the device to match (or edit this file): Scene Select = CC34, Tempo Tap = CC14, Tuner = CC15, External Controller 1-4 = CC16-19. Set the device's MIDI channel (SETUP > MIDI/Remote > General) to the channel configured in RigPilot's Device Settings. "Select Preset" assumes PC Mapping = OFF (presets load 1:1, Bank Select CC0 = preset bank of 128).

OneShot.name: Select Preset
OneShot.description: Loads a preset: bank (CC0) x 128 + program number. Requires PC Mapping = OFF.

OneShot.name: Select Scene
OneShot.description: Selects a scene of the current preset. Requires 'Scene Select' = CC34 in SETUP > MIDI/Remote > Other.

Automation.name: External Controller 1
Automation.description: Continuous control mapped to External 1 (convention: CC16).

Automation.name: External Controller 2
Automation.description: Continuous control mapped to External 2 (convention: CC17).

Automation.name: External Controller 3
Automation.description: Continuous control mapped to External 3 (convention: CC18).

Automation.name: External Controller 4
Automation.description: Continuous control mapped to External 4 (convention: CC19).

OneShot.name: Tap Tempo
OneShot.description: A single tempo tap (convention: 'Tempo Tap' = CC14 in SETUP > MIDI/Remote > Other).

OneShot.name: Tuner
OneShot.description: Shows or hides the tuner (convention: 'Tuner' = CC15, 64-127 = on, 0-63 = off).
